protocol.primary_total_tokens: Full pipeline: Selector + Decomposer + optional Refiner for MAC; Decomposer + optional Refiner for frozen GERT
protocol.context_reduction: End-to-end: zero for MAC because its Selector reads the full union schema; GERT is measured against the full union schema
protocol.downstream_context_reduction: Diagnostic only: candidate schema reduction after selection
protocol.gert_routing_cost: Excluded because GERT predictions are frozen inputs
protocol.model_parameters: Provider defaults; no sampling parameters sent
protocol.selector_db_id: Gold db_id hidden; used only for SQLite execution/evaluation
